sentences.text:
Applicant
 V/s.
 The State of Maharashtra ...

Respondent
 Mr. Nilesh S. Kumbhar, for the Applicant
 Mrs. Veera Shinde, App for the State/Respondent.

Coram : Amit Borkar, J.
 Dated : August 17, 2023
 P.C.:
1.

The application is in relation to C.R. No.1435 of 2022, for offences punishable under Sections
498A, 323, 504, 506, r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. According to prosecution, during pendency of the present application, the victim has went missing.
Accordingly, missing report bearing No.57 of 2023, registered at Hadapsar Police Station.
3. Therefore, the respondent is at liberty to investigate in accordance with law.
4. Ad-interim relief granted earlier to continue till 7 th September 2023.

(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
